tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: A Show Cause Notice (SCN) dated March 05, 2025 was issued by the Principal Commissioner of Customs, Noida, requiring the Company to explain the correctness of the forms submitted in support of preferential duty benefits availed on certain imports of raw materials from the ASEAN region. The Authority challenged the eligibility of the said products to claim such duty benefit. Aggrieved by the same, the Company, along with other similarly placed importers, has filed a Writ Petition before the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi, being W.P.(C) 19112/2025, challenging the said action of the Authority.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Principal Commissioner of Customs, Noida Customs Commissionerate
tax_litigation.status: The Delhi High Court, vide its order dated April 28, 2026, disposed of the writ petition and upheld the validity of the SCN. Aggrieved by this decision, the Company preferred a Special Leave Petition (SLP) before the Supreme Court of India, which was filed on May 21, 2026, under Diary No. 32023/2026. The matter is currently pending for hearing before the apex court.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: A search operation was conducted at the Company's premises on apprehension of contravention of the provisions of the GST Act, and of maintaining accounts/goods in a manner likely to cause evasion of tax. The search has since been completed, and the matter is presently pending before the Jurisdictional Office of GST, with the Company awaiting the next date of hearing.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Additional Commissioner (Departmental), State Tax, Jurisdiction Uttarakhand
tax_litigation.status: Company has received summons on July 15, 2026 for hearing on July 23, 2026.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: As per the disclosure submitted by the Company to the Stock Exchanges dated March 23, 2026, a demand of Rs. 29.03 Crores is imposed on the Company. The Company has filed appeal before CIT (A) of Income Tax Department as on March 31, 2026
tax_litigation.status: Income tax demand has been reduced to Rs. 5,99,71,448/- through rectification oder issued by Jurisdictional officer under Section 154 dated June 15, 2026.
